scripts.dev: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$conns=Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($conns){$procIds=$conns | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; foreach($procId in $procIds){Stop-Process -Id $procId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue}}; node server.js"
